description: This file defines a class for generating sales pipeline analytics reports, including data retrieval, processing, and chart data preparation within the ERPNext system.

classes.name: SalesPipelineAnalytics
classes.description: A class for generating sales pipeline analytics reports, including data fetching, processing, and chart data creation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Entry point function that creates an instance of SalesPipelineAnalytics with optional filters and runs the report.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the SalesPipelineAnalytics object with filters.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the report generation process, including getting columns, data, and chart data.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the report columns based on filters.

methods.name: set_range_columns
methods.description: Sets columns for monthly or quarterly ranges.

methods.name: set_pipeline_based_on_column
methods.description: Sets the first column based on pipeline grouping (Owner or Sales Stage).

methods.name: get_fields
methods.description: Determines fields for data queries based on filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and processes data from the database based on filters.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds query conditions based on filters.

methods.name: get_periodic_data
methods.description: Processes query results into periodic data grouped by month or quarter.

methods.name: set_formatted_data
methods.description: Formats and stores data for a specific period and pipeline group.

methods.name: check_for_assigned_to
methods.description: Filters data for specific assigned users.

methods.name: get_month_list
methods.description: Generates a list of upcoming months starting from current month.

methods.name: append_to_dataset
methods.description: Aggregates data into datasets for charting.

methods.name: append_data
methods.description: Prepares the final data structure for report output.

methods.name: get_default_currency
methods.description: Retrieves the default currency for the company.

methods.name: get_currency_rate
methods.description: Fetches exchange rate between two currencies, with caching.

methods.name: convert_to_base_currency
methods.description: Converts opportunity amounts to the company's base currency.
